description: Six-month operational history for the simulated bank's service fleet. This data lives in Postgres, not Prometheus — see the BankOps Postgres datasource note — so every panel here is SQL, not PromQL.

list.name: service
list.label: Service
list.query: SELECT slug AS __value, name AS __text FROM services ORDER BY name

targets.rawSql:
SELECT m."recordedAt" AS time, s.name AS metric, m.value
FROM metrics m JOIN services s ON s.id = m."serviceId"
WHERE m."metricName" = 'error_rate_percent'
  AND $__timeFilter(m."recordedAt")
  AND ('$service' = '$__all' OR s.slug = '$service')
ORDER BY 1

SELECT m."recordedAt" AS time, s.name AS metric, m.value
FROM metrics m JOIN services s ON s.id = m."serviceId"
WHERE m."metricName" = 'p99_latency_ms'
  AND $__timeFilter(m."recordedAt")
  AND ('$service' = '$__all' OR s.slug = '$service')
ORDER BY 1

SELECT m."recordedAt" AS time, s.name AS metric, m.value
FROM metrics m JOIN services s ON s.id = m."serviceId"
WHERE m."metricName" = 'availability_percent'
  AND $__timeFilter(m."recordedAt")
  AND ('$service' = '$__all' OR s.slug = '$service')
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Synthetic transaction success rate (SLI)
panels.description: Canary probes for the customer journeys that matter most: login, balance check, funds transfer, card payment, mobile login.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT m."recordedAt" AS time, s.name || ' — ' || split_part(m."metricName", '.', 2) AS metric, m.value
FROM metrics m JOIN services s ON s.id = m."serviceId"
WHERE m."metricName" LIKE 'synthetic.%success_rate'
  AND $__timeFilter(m."recordedAt")
  AND ('$service' = '$__all' OR s.slug = '$service')
ORDER BY 1

SELECT m."recordedAt" AS time, s.name || ' — ' || split_part(m."metricName", '.', 2) AS metric, m.value
FROM metrics m JOIN services s ON s.id = m."serviceId"
WHERE m."metricName" LIKE 'synthetic.%latency_ms'
  AND $__timeFilter(m."recordedAt")
  AND ('$service' = '$__all' OR s.slug = '$service')
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: SLA actual vs target (daily)
panels.description: Select a single service for a clean actual-vs-target read; "All" overlays every service's actual line only.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sla."windowStart" AS time, sla."actualPercent"::float AS "actual %", sla."targetPercent"::float AS "target %"
FROM sla_records sla JOIN services s ON s.id = sla."serviceId"
WHERE sla."windowType" = 'DAILY'
  AND $__timeFilter(sla."windowStart")
  AND ('$service' = '$__all' OR s.slug = '$service')
ORDER BY 1

SELECT sla."windowStart" AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sla.breached) AS "breached services"
FROM sla_records sla
WHERE sla."windowType" = 'MONTHLY' AND $__timeFilter(sla."windowStart")
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Incidents opened per week by severity

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('week', i."openedAt") AS time, i.severity AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM incidents i
WHERE $__timeFilter(i."openedAt")
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT sla."windowStart" AS time,
  avg(sla."meanTimeToDetectMinutes"::float) AS "MTTD (min)",
  avg(sla."meanTimeToRecoverMinutes"::float) AS "MTTR (min)"
FROM sla_records sla
WHERE sla."windowType" = 'WEEKLY' AND $__timeFilter(sla."windowStart")
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: P99 latency distribution over time (select a service above)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT m."recordedAt" AS time, m.value AS "p99_latency_ms"
FROM metrics m JOIN services s ON s.id = m."serviceId"
WHERE m."metricName" = 'p99_latency_ms'
  AND $__timeFilter(m."recordedAt")
  AND ('$service' = '$__all' OR s.slug = '$service')
ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.name AS "Service", s.tier AS "Tier", d."dependencyType" AS "Dependency", u.name AS "Depends On"
FROM service_dependencies d
JOIN services s ON s.id = d."serviceId"
JOIN services u ON u.id = d."dependsOnServiceId"
ORDER BY s.name

panels.title: Runbook executions per week by outcome

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('week', ir."executedAt") AS time, ir.outcome AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM incident_runbooks ir
WHERE $__timeFilter(ir."executedAt")
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT r.title AS "Runbook", r.category AS "Category", count(*) AS "Executions",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE ir.outcome = 'SUCCESS') AS "Success",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE ir.outcome = 'PARTIAL') AS "Partial",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE ir.outcome = 'FAILURE') AS "Failure"
FROM incident_runbooks ir JOIN runbooks r ON r.id = ir."runbookId"
GROUP BY r.title, r.category
ORDER BY count(*) DESC

panels.title: Error budget consumed (latest monthly window, by service)
panels.description: errorBudgetConsumedMinutes / errorBudgetMinutes for each service's most recent monthly SlaRecord — how much of this month's allowed downtime is already spent.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.id) s.name AS metric,
  (sla."errorBudgetConsumedMinutes"::float / NULLIF(sla."errorBudgetMinutes"::float, 0)) * 100 AS value
FROM sla_records sla JOIN services s ON s.id = sla."serviceId"
WHERE sla."windowType" = 'MONTHLY'
ORDER BY s.id, sla."windowStart" DESC

panels.title: Error budget burn (daily, fleet-wide)
panels.description: Sum of errorBudgetConsumedMinutes vs errorBudgetMinutes across services per day — the burn-down an SRE lead checks to see if the fleet is on pace to exhaust its budget before month end.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sla."windowStart" AS time,
  sum(sla."errorBudgetConsumedMinutes"::float) AS "consumed (min)",
  sum(sla."errorBudgetMinutes"::float) AS "budget (min)"
FROM sla_records sla JOIN services s ON s.id = sla."serviceId"
WHERE sla."windowType" = 'DAILY'
  AND $__timeFilter(sla."windowStart")
  AND ('$service' = '$__all' OR s.slug = '$service')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
